channel.order_effects: both merge rules are commutative sums applied at every position at once, so neither arm has an order or a recency effect by construction; the reported dominance evidence is packet geometry and prompt alignment

deterministic: the design is deterministic given the checkpoint -- fixed scenarios, fixed prompts, greedy decode, no training -- so there is no seed column and no replication is claimed
